svg.title: The Hodge theaters of inter-universal Teichmüller theory, with jokes — docs/DATA_MODEL.md §5

text.font-family: Inter, 'Inter Display', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Liberation Sans', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The Hodge theaters of inter-universal Teichmüller theory, with jokes

text.font-family: Inter, 'Inter Display', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Liberation Sans', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A Hodge theater is one complete, self-contained copy of the arithmetic of an elliptic curve over a number field: local Frobenioids at every v ∈ V, a global realified Frobenioid, and capsules of prime-strips labelled by the l-torsion, tied

text.font-family: Inter, 'Inter Display', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Liberation Sans', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: together by bridges. Two copies living in different universes can then be compared by links that are weaker than ring isomorphisms. [IUTchI] builds them in stages: the Θ-HT (§3), the ΘNF-HT (§4–5) and the Θ±ell-HT (§6), and then glues

text.font-family: Inter, 'Inter Display', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Liberation Sans', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the last two into the Θ±ell NF-HT, one vertex of the log-theta-lattice ([IUTchIII] Def 1.4). Every number below is what the toolkit computes for abc(1,2400,2401) l=13 (iut walk). Every type also gets a joke from Japanese pop culture, because

text.font-family: Inter, 'Inter Display', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Liberation Sans', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the theory is very long and the reader deserves a break.

svg.text: Anatomy of one vertex • : a Θ±ell NF-Hodge theater

text.font-family: Inter, 'Inter Display', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Liberation Sans', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Top band: the Θ±ell-Hodge theater, built on the additive symmetry F_l^{⋊±}. Bottom band: the ΘNF-Hodge theater, built on the multiplicative symmetry F_l^*. Each band is a capsule of prime-strips with a bridge out to each side. The grey threads between the two capsules are the

text.font-family: Inter, 'Inter Display', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Liberation Sans', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: gluing of [IUTchI] Prop 6.7, drawn exactly as iut run MapLabels prints it: ±t ↦ |t| ∈ F_l^*, while 0 and ⊞ both go to >. Bridge labels give the order of the isomorphism torsor.

text.font-family: Inter, 'Inter Display', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Liberation Sans', Arial, sans-serif
